title: Transfer: tests for walk(dirs)

blocks.md:
## Do not look at stdout

`walk(dirs)` returns the end `{ x, y }` starting from `{ x: 0, y: 0 }`. It must not call `Player`. Tests check the object. The stage is for seeing a fox, not for proving the math.

`east` adds 1 to `x`. `west` subtracts 1 from `x`. `south` adds 1 to `y`. `north` subtracts 1 from `y`.

Print `3,2` for three east and two south. A hidden test will send `west` then `north` and expect `{ x: -1, y: -1 }`.

choices.md: Call Player.move so the test watches the stage
Return coordinates the test can assert

blocks.explainMd: Origin is 0,0. Three east and two south end at 3,2. west and north go negative.

hintLadder.md: Start at `{ x: 0, y: 0 }`. Change `x` or `y` for each heading.
Return the object. Print `x + "," + y` for the sample path.

description: Write tests for a walk so a later change cannot silently break it.
